top_signals.title: Trump announces 'economic warfare' on Iran, threatens ‘tremendous’ consequences for its backers
top_signals.summary: The announcement extends a pressure campaign the Trump administration has waged since April under the banner Operation Economic Fury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Miner Fortescue’s Profit Falls as China Challenges Persist
top_signals.summary: Fortescue Ltd.’s full-year profit fell despite buoyant iron ore prices as China’s property slowdown and negotiations with the country’s state-backed buyer persisted.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
